checks.name: Desktop calendar uses the compact workspace rail, visible mini-calendar and four functional views
Anchored More menu supports arrows/Escape, and mini-calendar supports day and month keyboard movement
Filters use exact rooms, preserve cancelled drafts and keep empty selections explicit
Month selection preserves month mode; public holidays and observances retain separate meaning
Evening DL creation allocates two rooms for 75 per round, prevents conflicts and retains editable details
Classroom recurrence edits affect the declared series, while cancellation leaves occurrences unchanged
Copy and import-review flows stay explicit, atomic and reversible without a fake PDF parser
Dark calendar event surfaces remain dark with readable semantic text; reduced/solid/forced colors work
Staff can inspect calendar details but cannot create, copy, import or edit records
Next navigation between record/calendar retains manual draft and calendar filters without disk storage
Touch widths 375/390/430/768 retain all views, visible More and correctly sized date/time fields

limitations: Synthetic local data, no production integration or PDF/OCR parser
Chromium emulation; physical iPhone/Safari and Android UAT remains pending
